tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Rows, cards, sheets and inputs that sit on paper. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the Gap bands in Today, the track of the Voice picker, collapsed lists. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles and outlined chips (3:1 on paper, surface and sunken in every theme). Not 3:1 on signal-soft in dark: marks inside a selected state use on-signal-soft.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface, sunken and signal-soft. The Do quadrant fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper, surface and sunken: reason lines, metadata, timestamps.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one action colour: the primary button, the selected tab, the Plan quadrant, links. As text (quiet buttons, links) it reads at 4.5:1 on paper and surface only, never on sunken; put on-signal text on a signal fill.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected and hovered backgrounds: the chosen segment, a selected row. Put on-signal-soft or ink text on it; ink-muted reads on it too (5.5:1+), so pressed rows keep their reason lines.

tokens.name: on-signal-soft
tokens.usage: Text on signal-soft, for the label of a selected segment or chip.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: Marigold. Marks the present: the current-time pill in Today, the Delegate quadrant, the Voice only chip. Always a fill with on-now text or icons on it; never text, a hairline or a bare mark on paper (1.6:1 on light paper).

tokens.name: on-now
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a now fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue and destructive actions. As text it reads on paper and surface; on a fill use on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an Overdue badge or a failed-command banner. Put on-danger-soft text on it.

tokens.name: on-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft.

tokens.name: voice-1
tokens.usage: Silent: the fill of the first Voice meter bar, the lightest step of the ramp. Too light to stand alone (1.3:1 on light surface): a filled bar always keeps a voice-3 edge.

tokens.name: voice-2
tokens.usage: Out loud: the second bar of the Voice meter (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: voice-3
tokens.usage: Closed door: the third bar of the Voice meter, the step that allows the most (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, so it always lands on the ground (3:1 on paper and surface in every theme).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single top pick in Now, and the Task title in Voice only. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: Now, Today, Inbox, Weekly review.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen: Waiting, Not here, Overdue.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Task and Activity titles in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes stay on the Task until you clear them.
styles.usage: Running text: Notes, dialogs, the README.

styles.name: reason
styles.usage: The one-line reason under a Picker row, and metadata. Always ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, badges, segment labels and button text at small size.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Clock times, Estimates and durations in Today and on rows, so columns line up.

styles.name: time-large
styles.usage: The length of the current Gap at the top of Now.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between Voice meter bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; between a title and its reason line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a list row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title; padding in Voice only rows.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Separation between the top pick and the ranked list in Now.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the Voice meter bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the top pick in Now.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The quick-add field and the floating capture button.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the quick-add bar only; everything else is separated by line, not shadow.

typeScale.note: One size and one line height per type style, in rem so the Android font size applies. Components read these, never literal sizes, so the Text size and Line spacing settings can rewrite them.

tokens.name: font-size-display
tokens.usage: Font size of the display style: The single top pick in Now, and the Task title in Voice only. One per screen.

tokens.name: line-height-display
tokens.usage: Line height of the display style.

tokens.name: font-size-title
tokens.usage: Font size of the title style: Screen titles: Now, Today, Inbox, Weekly review.

tokens.name: line-height-title
tokens.usage: Line height of the title style.

tokens.name: font-size-heading
tokens.usage: Font size of the heading style: Section headings inside a screen: Waiting, Not here, Overdue.

tokens.name: line-height-heading
tokens.usage: Line height of the heading style.

tokens.name: font-size-body-strong
tokens.usage: Font size of the body-strong style: Task and Activity titles in lists.

tokens.name: line-height-body-strong
tokens.usage: Line height of the body-strong style.

tokens.name: font-size-body
tokens.usage: Font size of the body style: Running text: Notes, dialogs, the README.

tokens.name: line-height-body
tokens.usage: Line height of the body style.

tokens.name: font-size-reason
tokens.usage: Font size of the reason style: The one-line reason under a Picker row, and metadata. Always ink-muted.

tokens.name: line-height-reason
tokens.usage: Line height of the reason style.

tokens.name: font-size-label
tokens.usage: Font size of the label style: Chips, badges, segment labels and button text at small size.

tokens.name: line-height-label
tokens.usage: Line height of the label style.

tokens.name: font-size-time
tokens.usage: Font size of the time style: Clock times, Estimates and durations in Today and on rows, so columns line up.

tokens.name: line-height-time
tokens.usage: Line height of the time style.

tokens.name: font-size-time-large
tokens.usage: Font size of the time-large style: The length of the current Gap at the top of Now.

tokens.name: line-height-time-large
tokens.usage: Line height of the time-large style.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. Fixed: no setting lowers it.

tokens.name: tap-target-drive
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable in the Voice only theme.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a Task row in a list. Fixed: rows grow with larger text, never shrink below this.
